newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan launches campaign to tidy up streets of Ivory Coast's commercial capital
- Motor fuel pump prices rise further following liberalisation of sector to reflect world market trends.

- Head of Ivorian privatisation committee, Jean-Claude Brou, tells government newspaper in interview that largely Ivorian Africa Bell consortium was disqualified from race to buy controlling stake in state telecommunication company CI-TELCOM because its lacked formal participation of international operator and necessary bank guarantees
- 25 American companies look at investment opportunities in Ivory Coast
- Mini-bus crash in centre west Gagnoa region kills 21 people, injures 11, latest in a series of dramatic road accidents in Ivory Coast

- Coconut processing company SICOR says it increased turnover by 38.65 percent in its 1995/96 financial year (ended 30/09/96) thanks to increased sales of grated coconut, improved sale price and favourable dollar exchange rate
- Opposition Rally of the Republicans favours participation in broad-based government, opposition Ivorian Popular Front has reservations
- English-based investment bank group Equator, part of the HSBC group, advertises its services; says it has more than 20 years experience of working to help promote African economic development
